```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The COVID-19 pandemic has demonstrated that healthcare workers are heroes across the country.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Doctors, nurses, home health aides, physician's assistants, public health professionals, home care workers, nursing home workers, and cleaners and service workers have shown up to work every day despite dire shortages of personal protective equipment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Far too many healthcare workers have lost their lives to COVID-19.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Untold thousands of healthcare workers are suffering the mental and emotional strain of losing far too many patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Healthcare workers—a majority of whom are women of color—are often underpaid and lack access to paid sick days, paid family and medical leave, health insurance, and other benefits critical for their own health and the health of patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe all jobs in the caring economy must come with family-sustaining wages, good benefits, access to paid leave, fair and predictable schedules, access to training and professional development, and the ability to join a union and collectively bargain.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe all employers funded by taxpayer dollars must pay their workers at least $15 an hour.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe all employers funded by taxpayer dollars must protect workers' rights to organize.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
